The main takeaway from our work is that
the fluvial events in the Lapteve Sea are not only a result of the river discharge but are also a consequence of the regional atmospheric circulation.

the Laptev shelf was a highly sensitive recorder of environmental changes in the Lena River drainage basin and its adjacent landmasses, and that these changes are largely driven by the regional climate.
